<!-- root/.github/pull_request_template.md -->
## Summary

Describe the problem and what changed.

## Validation

Describe automated checks and manual tests, including versions and platforms.

## Risk and compatibility

List breaking changes, destructive operations, dependencies and rollback steps.

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or explained
- [ ] CI results reviewed
- [ ] Documentation updated where necessary
- [ ] No live secrets or customer data included
